# Voidone

> Voidone is the team behind Void, a Discord bot for moderation, welcome messages, levels and logging. Void is in beta.

## Facts
- Void bot site: https://bot.voidone.fun/
- Support server: https://dsc.gg/voidone
- Careers: https://voidone.fun/careers (we are looking for developers, designers, moderators, community managers and support people; applications are written in English and answered by email)
- Not affiliated with Discord
